messages:
Priya: quick sync from the modal pass  noticed footer CTAs feel cramped when the toast rails in from the top. proposal: add 8px bottom padding to modal content when a toast is visible and reduce footer horizontal gap from spacing-3 -> spacing-2 in compact.
Ethan: makes sense. do we have a rule to detect toasts present? maybe a `data-has-toast` attribute on body when toasts mount so modal can adapt.
Priya: yeah, something like `body[data-has-toast='true'] .modal { padding-bottom: calc(var(--modal-padding-bottom) + 8px); }` — avoids JS layout thrash.
Lina: accessibility nit  if we add padding dynamically, ensure focus order doesn't change. also the primary CTA label in the modal currently says "Dismiss" on confirmation modals; that reads weak. suggest "Close" or context-specific verb like "Confirm & close".
Marco: +1 on copy. "Dismiss" feels passive. i'd prefer "Close" for neutral, or "Done" when it's a success state. for destructive flows we keep verbs like "Delete".
Priya: good call. action: change generic dismiss -> "Close" and recommend contextual verbs in component docs.
Ethan: about spacing token change: compact footer gap to spacing-2 is fine if hit targets stay >=44px. please confirm. also toast z-index: some toasts are landing above modal footers even when they shouldn't  we should ensure toasts default z < modal z unless `breaks-modal` flag set.
Lina: yes, modal z should be 800, toast 500, persistent-toast 700 if needed. and add aria-live="polite" to toasts and role="status" so screen readers don't get noisy.
accessibility-bot: Automated accessibility checks queued.
accessibility-bot: Results: contrast of updated CTA background = 4.7:1 (AA pass). Focus visible for keyboard nav after padding change. Recommend: when changing copy from "Dismiss" to "Close", update aria-labels for screen reader clarity (e.g., aria-label="Close settings modal"). Also ensure `data-has-toast` is set before layout changes to avoid reflow during focus. :white_check_mark:
Marco: thanks bot. one more micro: when footer gap reduces, the ghost secondary control's outline looks thin. propose `focus-ring-compact: 2px` for ghost buttons in modal footers.
Priya: agreed. summary of actions: 1) compact footer gap -> spacing-2, 2) add 8px bottom padding when `data-has-toast` present, 3) change generic "Dismiss" -> "Close" with aria-label updates, 4) modal z-index 800, toast 500, persistent-toast 700, 5) apply `focus-ring-compact: 2px` to ghost buttons in footers. i'll update the figma and component docs and post the link here. thanks all :raised_hands:
